svg.title: Install the application tools before isolation — instructional mockup
svg.desc: Step-specific guided recreation. Not a genuine screenshot or live result.
svg.text: INSTRUCTIONAL MOCKUP — NOT A LIVE CAPTURE OR RESULT
Install the application tools before isolation
TLS-APP01 · RHEL 9 local console · Bash
RHEL 9 — learner@tls-app01
COMMAND / FILE CONTENT TO ENTER — PRESERVE CASE
sudo subscription-manager identity
# Run this only if the VM is not already registered:
sudo subscription-manager register
sudo dnf install -y nginx openssl openssh-server firewalld policycoreutils policycoreutils-python-
utils
sudo systemctl enable --now sshd firewalld
openssl version
nginx -v
EXPECTED RESULT / SIMULATED CLUE — CHECK YOUR OWN MACHINE
The tools install; OpenSSL reports 3.x and nginx reports a package version. Registration may use
Simple Content Access; do not assume an auto-attach command is required.
FOLLOW THE NUMBERED INSTRUCTIONS IN THE LESSON
1. Click the TLS-APP01 console and sign in as learner. Type the first command below and press Enter.
2. If your VM is not registered, run the registration command. Enter your own Red Hat username and
password only at the terminal prompts; skip registration if status already shows a valid identity.
3. Paste the package command. Type your learner password for sudo; type y only when you have reviewed
the package transaction.
4. Wait for Complete before starting the services. NGINX is not started yet; first we will set up its
page and configuration.
No real private key, real certificate result, production access or DoD endorsement is shown.
